completion_reason: Material validation and rollout decisions remain unresolved.

questions.label: Evidence safety
questions.context: Runs are immutable, but evidence may contain secrets or sensitive data.
questions.question: How should sensitive run evidence be stored?

choices.text: Redact before immutable persistence; reject evidence that cannot be safely redacted.
Encrypt raw evidence and expose only a redacted view.
Store raw evidence permanently with access controls.

questions.label: Crash consistency
questions.context: Canonical context, checkpoints, and artifacts must remain crash-safe.
questions.question: What consistency guarantee should a committed checkpoint provide?

choices.text: Atomically commit context, checkpoint, and artifact references together.
Commit independently and reconcile incomplete records after restart.
Allow partial commits but require manual recovery.

questions.label: Legacy rollout
questions.context: Streamlining may change schemas while existing product data must remain safe.
questions.question: How should existing runs and conversations be handled at rollout?

choices.text: Keep legacy data read-only and migrate lazily with rollback.
Perform a one-time in-place migration before launch.
Start clean and provide a legacy export only.
